Exercises › Quads

How to do the Barbell Back Squat

An intermediate compound exercise for the quads and glutes. You need a barbell and a squat rack or power rack.

How to do it

  1. Position the bar on your upper traps.
  2. Unrack and step back, feet shoulder-width apart.
  3. Brace your core and squat down until thighs are parallel.
  4. Drive through your heels to stand back up.
  5. Repeat.

Muscles worked

Main
Quads and Glutes
Also
Hamstrings and Lower back
Equipment
Barbell, Squat rack or Power rack
Level
Intermediate
